senses.gloss:
Two,Ⓒa.Ⓓdvi (dvO, dve f. n.), dvi pr.; dvayaM affixed; ‘t(wo) years’ dvivarzaM, varzadvayaM; ‘t(wo) or three’ dvitrAH; ‘t(wo)-fold’ dviguRa; ‘t(wo)-banded’ dvihasta; dvijihva &c.; ‘in t(wo) ways’ dviDA.
ⓃTwice,Ⓒadv.ⒹdviH, dvivAraM; ‘t(wice) married’ punarUQA, punarBUH (widow remarried); ‘20 is t(wice) 10’ dvirAvfttA daSa viMSatiH saMpadyaMte.
